messages:
Maya (Marketing): morning — quick async check for content/bench. Posted 3 draft benchmark writeups to the bench doc: https://redwood.ai/internal/benchmarks/landing-demo. TL;DR in-thread. What I did / blockers / today:

Maya (Marketing): What I did: published drafts, captured screenshots from staging, and ran a quick token/cost pass on the examples. Blocker: we saw unexpected token/cost spike on long prompt examples — need eng to confirm if that's runtime batching/quantization or prompt artifact. Today: iterate CTAs, update screenshots, and schedule post if eng confirms by EOD.

Jon (Eng): can you paste one of the problematic prompts/examples here? I can repro locally against the same model variant. :eyes:

Maya (Marketing): sample prompt pasted below:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-demo-13b-q4_0",
  "prompt": "Write a short case study about a fintech app using Redwood Inference. Include example prompt+response, perf numbers, and CTA.",
  "max_tokens": 800
}
```
Response had ~920 tokens and cost jumped ~2.3x on the long example.

Jon (Eng): thanks. that looks like the long max_tokens + continuous batching interaction. I'll run a replay on the serving cluster and check kernel/quantization path. @Leo can you watch GPU metrics for the run?

Leo (Infra): on it. starting a canary replay now against the same model/version and input. will share perf logs.

Sasha (Content): small ask — can we move the public benchmark post from Tue -> Wed if we need eng validation? That gives us a day for any updates and new screenshots. Also need approval for hero screenshot crop.

Caroline (Ops): noted — tentatively moved calendar slot to Wed AM, pending eng signoff. If deploy-bot confirms a successful canary by 15:00 PT we can keep that.

deploy-bot: Canary replay started (id: cb-1945601234). Watching for tail latency and memory spikes.

Jon (Eng): quick update — reproduced locally, looks like batching config `max_batch_delay_ms` is too aggressive for these long-`max_tokens` requests. Increasing delay reduces token duplication but might affect latency. Sharing diff in infra PR in ~15m.

Maya (Marketing): thanks. If increasing delay fixes cost we can keep wording; if not we may trim the long example. Also quick CR ping: @Jon on PR /marketing/bench-copy #412 — need review before I merge screenshots.

Jon (Eng): reviewing PR #412 now. should be done in 20–30m. :+1:

Leo (Infra): canary done — results: q4_0 variant runs ~12% fewer tokens in replay and tail latency within SLO. logs uploaded to the bench doc. No memory regressions.

Maya (Marketing): excellent — will update the drafts to reference q4_0 results and move the live post to Wed AM. Sasha, I'll drop the hero crops and new bench screenshots into the doc in 10m. Thanks everyone! :tada:

Sasha (Content): perfect — I'll prepare the social blurbs once final screenshots are in. :rocket:

Caroline (Ops): noted, final launch checklist updated.

Jon (Eng): merged infra diff to adjust batching defaults. keep an eye for any anomalies after canary.

Maya (Marketing): final note — if anything blocks merge/approval ping me here or DM. otherwise plan: ship Wed AM, monitor cost metrics first 2 hours. Cheers.
